text: Long catch up with Esme. Her mum's hip op is on Thursday at the Royal, she's staying with her for the week after. Esme's shattered already. Remind me to text her Friday to see how it went.
Coffee with Alfie and Jess. Jess turns 30 on 2 November 2026 and Alfie's planning a surprise dinner. She's really into pottery at the moment, apparently a wheel class voucher would go down well.

spans.text: wheel class voucher would go down well

text: Graham rang. Knee replacement finally booked for March 2027, he's been on the list nearly two years. Still walking the dog Bramble twice a day somehow. Need to pop round before then. His son Lorenzo is coming over from Milan for the op and staying a month. Graham mentioned his 75th is in January too, he wants a proper bird feeder for the garden, the squirrels wrecked the last one.

spans.text: wants a proper bird feeder for the garden

text: Caught up with Yetunde after church. Her brother Dmitri is visiting from Lagos next Tuesday for a fortnight. She wants us all to do Sunday lunch while he's here. Her twins start swimming lessons this weekend too. She's also been back and forth to the GP about her blood pressure, got a follow up on Monday. Should ring her after that to see what they said.
Zainab's surgery got cancelled again, third time now. She's fed up and in a lot of pain. Her husband's taking time off work to help with the kids. I should drop some food round tomorrow.
Met Connor for a pint. He's started at the council planning office, loves it so far. His girlfriend Rin is a vet nurse. They're moving in together in January.
Adaeze is doing her driving test on Friday and she's a nervous wreck about it. Third attempt. Text her good luck Thursday night.
Cem's dad had a stroke last week, he's in the Queen Elizabeth. Cem's flying back and forth from Istanbul. Don't forget to ring him at the weekend, he sounded really low.

spans.text: flying back and forth from Istanbul

text: Lunch with Isabel and Anya. Isabel's back at work after her gallbladder op, still sore but okay. Anya's off to Japan next month for three weeks. Isabel's birthday is the 14th, she mentioned wanting a decent pair of walking boots. Anya and I said we'd go halves.

spans.text: wanting a decent pair of walking boots

text: Phone call with Uncle Eamon. Cataract surgery on the left eye went fine yesterday, second one booked for 9 December 2026. Auntie Joy is doing all the driving. Must send them a card.

spans.text: Cataract surgery on the left eye

text: Abebe's daughter graduates from Leeds on Wednesday. He's so proud, couldn't stop showing me photos. She studied nursing.

Nikolai and Divya came over for dinner. Divya's pregnant, due in May 2027! Nikolai's already panicking about the spare room. Their cat Pickle hates the builders. They're coming back for Bonfire Night on the 5th.
Need to post Kemal's birthday present by Monday, he's in Edinburgh now.
Adriana mentioned she's had her MRI results back, nothing sinister, just a bulging disc. Physio twice a week from next Monday. She's relieved.
Chat with Anan at the school gate. His wife Aiko just had her wisdom teeth out, face like a hamster apparently. He's doing pickups all week. Their eldest Dong starts secondary in September.

Lorenzo's 40th is Saturday 7 November. Party at the Fox and Hounds. He's obsessed with Formula 1 at the moment, maybe a track day experience? Jamal is collecting money for something big, ask him how much.

spans.text: Party at the Fox and Hounds

text: Jada called. Her gran's in hospital with pneumonia, been there since Sunday. Jada's going up tomorrow with her mum. Remind me to check in with her on Wednesday.
Siddharth and Carmen are getting married in Seville in June 2027. Save the dates going out after Christmas. Carmen's sister Fern is maid of honour.
Dentist Tuesday 10am. Pick up prescription on the way back.
Saw Fern in town. Her dog Biscuit had a lump removed last week, all benign thankfully. She's off to Cornwall this weekend to celebrate.
Graham Johnson from next door says his wife's having her bunion op on 18 November 2026. He'll need help with the bins for a couple of weeks. I said I'd do them.
Esme said Alfie's struggling a bit since the redundancy, hasn't really left the house. Need to invite him for a walk this week, don't make a big thing of it.

Aleks (Aleksander) is back from Poland. His mum's recovering well from the bypass, home since last Friday. He brought me a jar of pickled mushrooms. Must get him that whisky I promised for his birthday next week.

spans.text: get him that whisky I promised

text: Video call with Rin and Connor. The housewarming is off, the move fell through at the last minute. They're staying put for now. Rin's still doing night shifts. Connor seemed really flat about it, said the buyers pulled out two days before exchange. I'm meeting him for a curry on Thursday anyway. Remind me to bring the board game he lent me.

spans.text: bring the board game he lent me

text: Isabel's knee arthroscopy went fine on Monday. She's on crutches for two weeks and bored out of her mind. Should send her some books, she loves crime thrillers.
Dmitri's turning 50 on 21 January 2027. Yetunde wants to do a surprise trip to Lisbon. He collects vinyl, especially old jazz pressings.
Divya rang, the 20 week scan is next Thursday. Nikolai can't go because of work so her mum's going with her.
Remind me to ask Jamal how his hernia op went, it was meant to be on Tuesday.

spans.text: ask Jamal how his hernia op went

text: Kemal's moving to Bristol in a fortnight for the new job. Leaving drinks are Friday at the Crown. Him and his partner Joy have found a flat near the harbour. Joy is starting a PhD there too.
Zainab's op finally happened yesterday! Two nights in and then home. Her sister Adaeze is staying to help. Don't forget to send flowers this week.

Anya's daughter is doing her Grade 5 piano exam next Saturday, she's been practising every evening and is properly nervous. Anya wants to take her for pizza afterwards. Anya herself has a mole being removed on Wednesday, minor thing, but she's been putting it off for months. Text her Wednesday night.

Long chat with Abebe on the phone. His wife had a fall at work and broke her wrist, surgery on Monday to pin it. He's taking the week off to look after the kids. Their son is struggling at uni too. Should call him again on Thursday and see how the op went. He also mentioned his 25th wedding anniversary is in March 2027, wants ideas.
Eamon's retiring at the end of December after 32 years at the railway. There's a do on 19 December 2026. Auntie Joy wants everyone to chip in for a new set of golf clubs.
Cem says his dad's out of hospital and doing rehab three times a week. Speech is coming back slowly. Cem's back in London from Sunday.
Grocery run tomorrow, then gym. Book the boiler service for next week.

Met Carmen for brunch. Siddharth's having his tonsils out on Friday, at 34, she says he's being a total baby about it. Carmen's working from home all next week to look after him. Text Sid on Saturday.
Adriana's turning 35 on the 3rd. Lorenzo's organising drinks. She's been going on about wanting a Kindle.
Graham's appointment with the consultant is next Wednesday, he's worried it's his heart again. Remind me to call him Wednesday evening.

Caught up with Jess and her partner Aiko. They've just got back from Iceland, saw the Northern Lights. Aiko's started a new job at the hospital in pharmacy. Jess is training for the Manchester half in April 2027. She's doing a 10k this Sunday as a warm up and asked if I'd come and cheer. Aiko's birthday is on 28 November 2026, she's into houseplants and anything matcha.

spans.text: new job at the hospital in pharmacy

text: Divya's mum is having a hysterectomy on 2 December 2026. Divya will be up north for a week after. I'm feeding Pickle while they're away.
Ran into Dong Le at the station. His dad's 70th is the weekend after next, big family meal. Dong's still at the bank, hates it.
Connor's sister Fern had her baby on Sunday! A little girl called Maya, 7lb 2oz. Mum and baby doing well. Must send something this week.
Nikolai's back surgery is postponed to February 2027 because of a bed shortage. He's on strong painkillers and off work. Need to check how he's coping next week.

Joy says Esme's daughter got into Oxford for medicine! Esme's over the moon. Graduation party in the summer. Esme's husband Eamon is less thrilled about the fees. Their son Alfie has his GCSE mocks next week and is apparently not revising at all. Should send Esme a congrats card.

Yetunde told me she's been feeling really overwhelmed with work and her dad's dementia getting worse. Her brother Dmitri isn't much help. She's thinking of going part time from January. I should take her out for lunch next week, just the two of us.
Jamal's birthday is Tuesday. He's really into bouldering right now, and his old chalk bag is falling apart.

spans.text: old chalk bag is falling apart

text: Anan's off for a colonoscopy on Thursday morning. He's a bit anxious but trying to joke about it. His wife Aiko is driving him.

Spoke to Aleksander and Kemal after five a side. Aleks has a hospital appointment about his shoulder tomorrow, might need surgery. Kemal's off to Turkey for his cousin's wedding the week after. Ask Aleks on Friday what the consultant said.
Rin's birthday next month. She keeps hinting about a fancy cocktail shaker set.

spans.text: hinting about a fancy cocktail shaker set

text: Alfie messaged. His interview at the BBC is on Monday 9 November, second round. He's quietly confident. Esme and him are also going to Rome for New Year.
Phoned Isabel Garcia about the book club, it's moved to Thursday. Her husband's recovering from Covid so she's staying in this week.
Lorenzo's mum Carmen is in hospital again, her diabetes is playing up. He's visiting every evening after work. He said not to worry, but I need to message him tomorrow.

Coffee with Adaeze, Zainab and Jada. Zainab's recovery is going really well, walking without the stick. Adaeze passed her driving test! Jada's moving to Leeds in March 2027 for her boyfriend. We're doing a farewell dinner for her in February.
Cancel the hair appointment Friday, clashes with the parents' evening.
Dmitri's knee is still swollen after the ACL repair three weeks ago. Physio says it's normal. He's frustrated he can't play football this season.
Esme's 40th is on 12 March 2027. Alfie's thinking of a weekend in the Cotswolds. Esme loves fancy candles and gardening stuff.
Rang Mrs Brennan for Mum. Her husband Abebe has his pacemaker check next Tuesday, and she's been poorly with shingles. Remind me to drop round some soup on Sunday.
Fern's having her gallbladder out in a fortnight. She's terrified of the anaesthetic, never had an op before. Her partner Jamal is taking her in. I want to send her a care package the day before.

Siddharth's back at work after the tonsils thing, says it was the worst week of his life. Carmen's planning his birthday for 30 December 2026, wants to do an escape room. Fern and Jamal are in, plus his cousin Divya. He's into retro gaming at the moment, so maybe an old Game Boy. Ask Carmen if anyone's already getting one.

spans.text: Ask Carmen if anyone's already getting one

text: Chat with Kemal. He's settled in Bristol, Joy's PhD starts in January 2027. Their dog Luna got neutered last week and is wearing the cone of shame. Plan a visit in the spring. Kemal's mum is coming over from Izmir for Christmas and staying till mid January, so not before then. He also said work is stressful, the new manager is a nightmare.
